context: Your round-3 picks, applied as the defaults. No y axis. Goal lines carry their values in the line's colour. Each faint reference line carries its value inside the plot in the same faint hue: the text is at 30% where the line is 12%, so it stays readable. Numbers move off readings, the ramp, the goal lines, tips and each other. A reference line at a goal value, or one with no clear spot, shows no number. The full and compact cards both set '1 lb' on a tight line. The frame height fits the tallest story, the three-card label set at 1920.
